question: Should ClawHub core own runtime promotional offers now, including the permanent promotions table, public/admin APIs, hosted feed, homepage surfacing, admin CLI, and production deploy publish step?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it creates durable product and release surface that automated review cannot accept on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept Core Promotions After Deploy Proof
options.body: Proceed with this PR after a maintainer verifies the new snapshot-publish step against a safe production-like deployment path.

options.title: Keep Draft Until Consumer Ships
options.body: Hold the producer branch until the OpenClaw `promos` consumer and launch-page/onboarding plan are ready to release together.

options.title: Defer Core Surface
options.body: Close or park this direction if promotions should remain external campaign content rather than a durable ClawHub platform entity.

recommendation.title: Accept Core Promotions After Deploy Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR after a maintainer verifies the new snapshot-publish step against a safe production-like deployment path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this feature and have prior merged ownership of adjacent catalog metadata surfaces, making them the best available routing owner for the product-direction packet.
